title: The closed unit cubes containing a point cover a neighbourhood of it (parent steps 5 and 6)
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ and x ∈ ℝ^P (Euclid P). There is a finite set Z ⊆ ℤ^P such that x ∈ z + [0,1]^P (i.e. z_i ≤ x_i ≤ z_i + 1 for all i) for every z ∈ Z, and every y in some neighbourhood of x lies in z + [0,1]^P for some z ∈ Z.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (x : Euclid P), ∃ Z : Finset (Fin P → ℤ), (∀ z ∈ Z, ∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ x i ∧ x i ≤ z i + 1) ∧ ∀ᶠ y : Euclid P in 𝓝 x, ∃ z ∈ Z, ∀ i, (z i : ℝ) ≤ y i ∧ y i ≤ z i + 1
